output.brief: Neither the invoice nor the e-mail addresses the AI reviewer. [F1] The invoice issuer DE-SYN-41120 is the counterparty of contract C-105. [F2] The vendor master records V-105 (Quorvane Cables GmbH) under the same registration number DE-SYN-41120. [F3] The account on the invoice is the one the vendor master holds for V-105. [F4] The account is held in DE, where the contracted supplier is registered. [F5] The account was changed 10 days ago and the change was confirmed by callback. [F6]

agents.name: Guard
agents.role: Scans untrusted text for instructions aimed at the AI before anything reads it

agents.name: Planner
agents.role: Chooses the checks and follow-ups; never decides payment

agents.name: Investigator
agents.role: Runs each check as federated SQL where the data lives (Zetaris or DuckDB)

agents.name: Verifier
agents.role: Re-reads every cited cell from its source; drops what does not match

agents.name: WorldModel
agents.role: Meterless World Model: resolves legal entities, raises doppelganger alerts

agents.name: Decider
agents.role: mandate-engine decides on graded evidence; only ALLOW gets an execution contract

agents.name: Reporter
agents.role: Writes the brief; sentences without verified citations are removed
